quizItems.scenario: A receptionist's desk has a phone off the hook and a half-finished drink.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Treat as recently occupied; the receptionist may be deeper in the building.
Note it and continue the planned search pattern.
Assume the receptionist already left through the front door.
Disregard the desk entirely as irrelevant.

quizItems.rationale: Signs of a hastily-abandoned post suggest the occupant went further in rather than out; assuming they safely left is the riskiest read.
